[[File:Lob.png|thumb|250px|Lob]]
(Japanese: '''ロブ''' ''Lob'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN025|A Festival Reunion!]]''.

Lob was among the {{pkmn|Trainer}}s competing in the [[World Coronation Series]] Battle Festival Challenge in [[Shalour City]]. He had a battle against {{Ash}}, where he used his {{p|Clawitzer}} against {{AP|Pikachu}}. Although Lob had a good strategy against {{type|Electric}} Pokémon, Ash was able to win, causing Lob's rank to go down.

Lob was later seen watching Ash's battle against {{an|Korrina}}.
